text:
sam: Hey team — customer (FinReg SaaS) reports intermittent stalls when using our node/ts SDK on Vercel edge. They see the ReadableStream stop yielding after ~12–20s, then SDK retries cause duplicate partial billing. They repro on 18.4.0 of our SDK and Node 18 edge runtime. Requesting escalation.

lina: Ugh, got a ticket link? any logs? did they say if auth token rotates mid-stream? :thinking:

sam: Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/CR-8421 (internal). Logs attached in ticket but here's the short log snippet they pasted: 
```
[2026-02-28T14:12:02Z] start stream req id=abcd-1234
[2026-02-28T14:12:14Z] auth refresh triggered, new token applied
[2026-02-28T14:12:15Z] stream chunk received (partial)
[2026-02-28T14:12:34Z] no further chunks, ReadableStream locked but controller.enqueue not called
[2026-02-28T14:12:34Z] sdk retry attempt 1 -> duplicate token used? billing increment
```

sam: They say it only happens on edge (Vercel), not on node-server.

diego: Can you paste their minimal repro? if it's small i can try on my vercel account.

sam: They provided this simplified TS snippet: 
```ts
import fetch from 'node-fetch'; // edge runtime uses fetch global in prod, we tested locally with node-fetch
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-bridge' })
});
const reader = res.body.getReader();
while(true){
  const { done, value } = await reader.read();
  if(done) break;
  // process chunk
}
```

sam: They also said they rotate the token on a timer (refresh on 10s), to simulate short-lived creds.

lina: Token rotation mid-stream could be a hint. Our SDK is supposed to maintain the same Authorization header for an open connection; rotates should only be used for new connections. Are they using our SDK client or direct fetch?

sam: They used direct fetch in repro but reported similar behavior when using our SDK wrapper (edge SDK 18.4.0).

support-bot: Automated note: customer impact = high, possible duplicate billing, label=escalation.

lina: Quick tests I want: (1) repro without token rotation (2) repro with rotation but using `Cache-Control: no-transform`? (3) check if Vercel proxy is closing the underlying socket on header change.

sam: I've asked the customer for a run with token stable and to confirm whether they see the hang. Meanwhile they asked for any mitigation we can suggest ASAP.

diego: Short mitigation: if they can't avoid rotating mid-stream, recommend creating a short-lived session token and use that for the entire stream duration (no rotation), or open a new stream per token. Also tell them to set retries=0 on the SDK to avoid duplicate billing while we triage.

lina: Good. Also add logging around stream `locked` state and `reader.cancel()` calls. If the stream is locked and we call a retry path, that could leave partial billing.

sam: Customer tried retries=0, still saw the stream hang but at least no duplicate charges. They prefer a fix rather than changing client logic.

eng-runtime: Tagging eng runtime — this smells like edge proxy+auth header swap race. Do you have packet-level timing or a HAR? Also which edge region?

sam: Customer ran from Vercel europe-west. I asked for HAR and a tcpdump but they need instructions.

eng-runtime: Thanks — meanwhile, can you capture these specifics and drop in a small instrumented repro I can run on our staging vercel deploy? I want: minimal app that (a) opens stream, (b) rotates header after Xs, (c) prints `reader.read()` time deltas. If it reproduces we can trace on the proxy.

sam: Will assemble and post here. ETA 2h. Also customer gave SDK version matrix: 
- SDK@18.4.0 (edge bundle) — reproducible
- SDK@17.9.2 — no repro

lina: Interesting version delta. 18.x added a retry wrapper and a small token refresh helper. Could be regression in the wrapper interacting with edge fetch.

diego: If 17.x no repro, bisect points to 18.x changeset. eng-runtime, can you look at the retry wrapper around streaming connect? maybe it triggers a reconnect that leaves previous reader locked.

eng-runtime: On it. If we find a bug, we should ship a 18.4.x patch or revert the retry-once behavior for edge. Also add a guard: if stream `locked` is true do not trigger an automatic retry path; prefer to wait for explicit cancel.

sam: Customer is ok with a short-term patch. I'll post the instrumented repro once ready. Thanks everyone :pray: 

lina: One more ask — QA: add a test that simulates auth header change mid-stream in an edge-like env (fast proxy) so we don't regress.

support-bot: Follow-up checklist created and assigned to eng-runtime, support. Priority=P1.
